title: ED: your account was used as a money mule

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Am I speaking to Mrs. Lata Iyer? This call is from the Enforcement Directorate, Delhi zonal office.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your savings account received money from a hawala network. Fourteen accounts are under investigation and yours is one of them.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: That must be a mistake, I am a retired teacher.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Then you will cooperate. Until the investigation closes you are under watch. Don't discuss this with your son, he could also be named.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: For the audit, move your entire balance to the RBI escrow account I will send. It is returned in 48 hours once your funds are cleared.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If the transfer is not done by evening, a non-bailable warrant will be issued in your name.
